acceptance_rule.reason: transistor-level SPICE can narrow the converter target, but the project schema still requires post-layout simulation or measured silicon before the break-even assumptions are replaced

claim_boundary.allowed: defines the exact SPICE work needed to replace the behavioral converter terms with circuit-derived terms
claim_boundary.not_allowed: does not claim a designed converter exists, does not claim extracted parasitics, does not claim measured silicon, and does not upgrade board energy

required_output_fields: adc_energy_per_conversion with units and rail voltage
dac_energy_per_row_drive with units and row load
conversion_time_ns from the timed decision path
settling_time_ns from the row-drive and sample path
output_noise_rms from transition, comparator, settling, and driver terms
adc_area_um2 and dac_area_um2 if layout exists, otherwise explicit area proxy
sharing rule that names rows, columns, instances, and outputs per conversion cost
netlist path, model corner, simulator command, seed if noise is randomized, and date

required_testbenches.acceptance: absolute settled error stays below half of one 10-bit DAC step and the row-driver noise term stays within the evidence budget
required_testbenches.measurement: settled voltage error after the allowed settling window
required_testbenches.name: 10-bit row DAC settling
required_testbenches.object: row-driver DAC output node before the crossbar row input
required_testbenches.stimulus: step through low, midscale, and near-full-scale codes with the selected row load attached

required_testbenches.acceptance: RMS readout error plus comparator noise stays below the budget carried by the behavioral estimate
required_testbenches.measurement: code transition error, comparator decision noise, conversion time, and failed-decision cases
required_testbenches.name: 12-bit SAR readout decision
required_testbenches.object: ADC comparator, capacitor ladder or equivalent DAC, reference path, and sample node
required_testbenches.stimulus: sweep input around every critical transition used by the selected output range

required_testbenches.acceptance: sharing does not push total output noise above 0.004 and does not remove the break-even margin in the passing 64-row shared scenario
required_testbenches.measurement: extra settling error, added conversion latency, and loading-dependent noise
required_testbenches.name: shared converter loading
required_testbenches.object: four shared converter instances serving the 64-row, 4-column, 16-output sharing point
required_testbenches.stimulus: toggle the muxed source, output load, and sample timing across the sharing schedule

required_testbenches.acceptance: energy fields can replace the relative behavioral units with SPICE-derived numbers and a named voltage rail
required_testbenches.measurement: integrated supply energy per row drive and per output conversion
required_testbenches.name: energy accounting
required_testbenches.object: row DAC references, ADC references, comparator, switch ladder, sampling capacitors, and mux control
required_testbenches.stimulus: same conversion sequence used in the accuracy replay
